name: Ubo
author: Romain Meynet (chezrom)
description: A Qix-like: draw lines to cut off parts of the field and claim them while the enemies roam. On-screen d-pad and Draw. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

descriptions.en: A Qix-like: draw lines to cut off parts of the field and claim them while the enemies roam. On-screen d-pad and Draw. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.
descriptions.it: Un gioco alla Qix: traccia linee per ritagliare e conquistare parti del campo mentre i nemici vagano. Croce direzionale e Traccia sullo schermo. Un gioco LÖVE sul motore Lua App.
